first_session_dialogue: Your tomato plants are huge this year.
I started them indoors in March, that helped a lot.
Could you show me how you did it?
Sure, bring some seed trays on Saturday.
second_session_dialogue: I brought the seed trays like you said.
Great, fill them with the fine compost first.
How deep should the seeds go?
Just a finger tip deep, then water gently.
third_session_dialogue: Keep them on the brightest windowsill you have.
They are leaning towards the glass.
Turn the trays a little every day.
fourth_session_dialogue: I planted them out in the garden today.
Did you harden them off first?
Yes, a week outside during the day.
fifth_session_dialogue: This year I have more tomatoes than you!
The student has become the teacher.
I saved seeds for you from the best plant.
Thank you, I will start them in March.
